name: fip
description: FIP — Real-Time Fashion Voting PWA (React + Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2)

scripts.dev: npm run setup:local && concurrently -k -n web,api -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run db:seed:gen && wrangler d1 execute fip-db --local --file=./worker/src/db/seed.generated.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run db:seed:gen && wrangler d1 execute fip-db --remote --file=./worker/src/db/seed.generated.sql
scripts.setup:local: npm run gen:icons && npm run build:web && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.setup:remote: npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run db:seed:remote
scripts.deploy: npm run gen:icons && npm run build:web && wrangler deploy
